description.value: A Parks Canada national historic site on the banks of the Fraser River, Fort Langley recreates life at a Hudson's Bay Company fur trading post from the 1800s. Visitors can explore rough-hewn timber buildings inside a log palisade, meet costumed interpreters, and participate in hands-on workshops. The site also offers oTENTik overnight camping within the fort walls.
